quicksilver.options.metal.tooltip:
On: Quicksilver draws the game with Metal, the Mac's own graphics.
Off: the game uses OpenGL or Vulkan, as the Graphics API row on Sodium's General page says. Quicksilver's shader packs draw only on Metal.
Applies after a restart.
quicksilver.options.colors.tooltip:
Vivid: the strong colors of Display P3.
Accurate: colors matched from sRGB, as OpenGL and Vulkan show them unless a mod changes it.
Automatic: Vivid when the mod mac-colorspace-rollback is installed, otherwise Accurate.
Applies at once.
quicksilver.options.hud.tooltip: Apple's Metal Performance HUD in a corner of the screen: frames per second, GPU time, memory and whether the frames go straight to the display.
quicksilver.options.hud.restart: Turning it on applies after a restart.
quicksilver.options.locked: Set by the launch command (%s), so this page cannot change it.
quicksilver.options.locked_launcher: Set by the launcher's environment (%s), so the HUD stays off and this page cannot change it.
quicksilver.options.not_on_metal: The game is not running on Metal now.
quicksilver.options.blocked.platform: Quicksilver needs a Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 15 or newer. Here the game uses OpenGL or Vulkan, as the Graphics API row on Sodium's General page says.
quicksilver.options.blocked.intel: Quicksilver's Metal library is for Apple silicon, and the game runs on an Intel Java here (an Intel Mac, or Rosetta). On an Apple silicon Mac, choose a Java for Apple silicon in the launcher.
quicksilver.options.blocked.iris: Iris is installed. Iris draws only with OpenGL, so Quicksilver stays off and the game starts without Metal. For shader packs on Metal, remove Iris: Quicksilver draws them itself.
quicksilver.options.graphics_api_note: Quicksilver: while Use Metal is on (Video Settings, Quicksilver), Metal draws the game and this choice waits.
quicksilver.shaders.packs.title: Shader packs
quicksilver.shaders.status.not_in_use: Not in use. Press Apply to use it.
quicksilver.shaders.status.list_failed: Could not read the shaderpacks folder: %s
quicksilver.shaders.locked: Set at launch by %s, so this cannot change here.
quicksilver.shaders.options.title: Shader pack options: %s
quicksilver.shaders.options.values_unrea: The defaults show, as in the game: the pack's options file could not be read. Apply replaces it. (%s)
quicksilver.shaders.option.no_list: The pack gives this value no list, so it cannot change here.
quicksilver.shaders.option.ambiguous: The pack declares this option twice with different defaults, so it cannot change here.
quicksilver.shaders.hand_depth.tooltip: How far the first-person hand sits in front of the view. Applies when the pack reloads.
quicksilver.options.shaders.tooltip:
On: Quicksilver's own engine draws the shader pack you chose under Shader packs.
Off: the game without a shader pack.
Applies at once.
quicksilver.options.packs.tooltip: Choose a shader pack and change its options.
quicksilver.options.upscale.tooltip:
Draws the shader pack's world at a smaller size, and Apple's MetalFX makes the picture full size again. Faster, but a little softer.
Off: the full size.
Quality: 1.5 times smaller on each side.
Performance: 2 times smaller on each side.
Applies at once.
quicksilver.shaders.toast.see_log: The game log names the reason.
quicksilver.shaders.key.no_pack: Shaders on, but no pack is chosen. Open the shader pack screen.
